name: POUNCE
tagline: A daily hunt for AI-company contests, grants, credits and hackathons, deadlines verified
description: Once a day it sweeps what AI companies are offering by way of contests, grant programs, free credits and hackathons. Every deadline is re-checked on the page that announced it, and anything you have already seen is held back. What reaches you is a short list of genuinely new chances to apply.
author: teeRex247
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
